name: What is the typical cost range for replacing a window with a rotted frame in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for replacing a window with a rotted frame in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for replacing a window with a rotted frame in areas like Daly City can vary significantly. Factors include the extent of rot remediation needed, the type and size of the new window, and installation complexities. Generally, expect costs to include window unit price plus labor for removal of the old window, structural repair, installation of the new unit, and finishing. Obtaining a detailed estimate is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on rot severity, window type/size, and installation complexities; obtain a detailed estimate.
